{{ $labels.host }} 的 {{ $labels.target_job }} 目标从采集序列中消失
annotations.description: 目标来自在用设备配置；其他设备或重复序列不会抵消本设备缺失。先核对服务发现及采集链路。

annotations.summary: 端口基线规则缺失，请检查 inventory.yml 的生成与加载

rules.expr: (monitoring:port:inventory * on(source_job,source_instance,source_ifName) group_left() (max by(source_job,source_instance,source_ifName)(label_replace((label_replace((label_replace(((max by(job,instance,ifName)(ifOperStatus{job=~"q3400-snmp|sonic-snmp|fortigate-snmp"}) == bool 1) and on(job,instance,ifName) (time() - max by(job,instance,ifName)(timestamp(ifOperStatus{job=~"q3400-snmp|sonic-snmp|fortigate-snmp"})) < __FRESHNESS__) and on(job,instance) ((max by(job,instance)(up{job=~"q3400-snmp|sonic-snmp|fortigate-snmp"}) == 1) and on(job,instance) (time() - max by(job,instance)(timestamp(up{job=~"q3400-snmp|sonic-snmp|fortigate-snmp"})) < __FRESHNESS__))),"source_job","$1","job","(.+)")),"source_instance","$1","instance","(.+)")),"source_ifName","$1","ifName","(.+)")))) or on(job,instance,ifName) (-1 * monitoring:port:inventory)

annotations.description: inventory.yml 声明应在线，SNMP 新鲜且接口非 up，持续 5 分钟。一条物理链路只报一次；采集失败/过期单独报未知。role={{ $labels.port_role }} link_id={{ $labels.link_id }}。
annotations.dashboard_url: {{ if eq $labels.network "firewall" }}__DASHBOARD_ROOT__/d/fortigate-snmp{{ else if eq $labels.network "ethernet" }}__DASHBOARD_ROOT__/d/sonic-snmp{{ else }}__DASHBOARD__{{ end }}

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.site }} 规划连接 down，需核实在用情况：{{ $labels.a_device }} {{ $labels.a_port }} ↔ {{ $labels.b_device }} {{ $labels.b_port }}
annotations.description: 规划要求在线但本次未能通过对端发现确认接线；仍计入期望并展示 down。先核实历史停用或真实断链，确认在用后升级到正式链路告警。两端按 link_id 去重。

annotations.description: 采集失败、样本过期或接口序列缺失。按设备汇总，避免误报为大量断链。

rules.expr: monitoring:internet:interface * on(instance,ifName) group_left() ((max by(instance,ifName)(rate(ifHCInOctets{job="fortigate-snmp"}[5m])) * 8) and on(instance,ifName) (time() - max by(instance,ifName)(timestamp(ifHCInOctets{job="fortigate-snmp"})) < __FRESHNESS__) and on(instance) ((max by(instance)(up{job="fortigate-snmp"}) == 1) and on(instance) (time() - max by(instance)(timestamp(up{job="fortigate-snmp"})) < __FRESHNESS__)))

monitoring:internet:interface * on(instance,ifName) group_left() ((max by(instance,ifName)(rate(ifHCOutOctets{job="fortigate-snmp"}[5m])) * 8) and on(instance,ifName) (time() - max by(instance,ifName)(timestamp(ifHCOutOctets{job="fortigate-snmp"})) < __FRESHNESS__) and on(instance) ((max by(instance)(up{job="fortigate-snmp"}) == 1) and on(instance) (time() - max by(instance)(timestamp(up{job="fortigate-snmp"})) < __FRESHNESS__)))

count by(site,edge)(monitoring:internet:interface) - on(site,edge) (count by(site,edge)(monitoring:internet:ingress_bps and on(site,edge,device,instance,ifName) monitoring:internet:egress_bps) or on(site,edge) (0 * count by(site,edge)(monitoring:internet:interface)))
